name: Cobeña (Spain)
description: Divided per saltire, yellow at the hoist and the fly and green above and below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cobeña (bars, fleurs-de-lis and the words AVE MARIA).
history: Municipal flag of Cobeña; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
